findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "read_feed" stacks urgency/override words (important, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

findings.detail: Description of "post_message" references sensitive artifacts (credentials). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: read_feed, post_message, get_stats · Private data: post_message · Public sink: post_message.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: read_feed, post_message, get_stats · Private data: post_message · Public sink: post_message

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "post_message" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
